topic: Useful and harmful changes in materials
key_concepts: Some changes in materials are useful to the environment
Some changes in materials are harmful to the environment
Harmful changes can cause pollution of land, water, and air
Deforestation destroys wildlife and causes floods, soil erosion, drought, and global warmi
Cutting cloth into handkerchiefs or clothes is a useful material change
Shaping wood into chairs and changing wood into charcoal are useful changes
Burning old tires and plastics releases dangerous toxic chemicals
Dumping garbage on land causes land pollution and breeds disease-carrying pests
Dumping garbage and chemical wastes into rivers pollutes water and can kill fish and water
Smoke from factories and vehicles causes air pollution and respiratory diseases
Cutting down trees affects air quality, temperature, rainfall, and weather patterns
The 5Rs—Reduce, Reuse, Recycle, Repair, and Rot—help prevent or minimize pollution
